response.text: Now the AP-to-GL tie-out, duplicate invoices, payment checks.

arguments.sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", x.dr, x.cr, x.ap_cr, x.ap_dr from "APINVH" i left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr, sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' then "CR_AMT" end) ap_cr, sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' then "DR_AMT" end) ap_dr from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO") x on x."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where coalesce(case when i."INV_AMT">=0 then x.ap_cr else x.ap_dr end,-1) <> abs(i."INV_AMT")

select upper(regexp_replace(trim("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) v, regexp_replace(upper("INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') n, count(*), array_agg("INV_ID"), array_agg("INV_NO"), array_agg("INV_AMT") from "APINVH" group by 1,2 having count(*)>1

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_DT" from "APPAYM" p left join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" where i."INV_ID" is null or p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" or i."STAT_CD"<>'P' or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
